# scripts/testdata — self-generated fixtures (clean-room)

Everything here was generated by this toolchain or by the task author from
first principles. **No dump content, vendor images, code, logos or trademark
strings are present.** Files are deliberately tiny (total well under 100 KB) so
CI stays fast.

| File | Size | Origin |
|------|------|--------|
| `gradient_rgb.png` | ~2 KB | 64×16 gradient: x→R, y→G, B=0.5. Synthetic; used by `validate_looks.py` and `selftest.py`. |
| `identity_8.cube` | ~14 KB | 8³ identity LUT, written in the exact `.cube` layout `parse_luts.write_cube` emits (red index fastest). Reference for round-trip/no-op checks. |
| `warm_8.cube` | ~14 KB | 8³ affine "warm" look (R×0.9+0.05, G×0.95+0.02, B×0.8). A non-trivial derived look for change-detection. |

Regenerate at any time (requires numpy + opencv-python-headless):

```bash
python scripts/validate_looks.py --make-gradients scripts/testdata
```

(`selftest.py` additionally builds a *tiled LUT PNG* in a temp dir at run time
to exercise the `parse_luts` decoder end-to-end, then discards it.)
